This will help you create a good foundation for decorating and make the process more efficient. 2. **Setting up the main decorations**: Focus on putting up the main decorations, such as the rangoli designs, torans (door hangings), and any other large decorative items. This will give you a sense of the overall look and feel of your home. 3. **Preparing the diyas**: Make or buy the diyas and light them up in the evening to get a sense of the ambiance. You can also place them in strategic locations to create a warm and inviting glow. Once these tasks are complete, you can move on to the smaller details, such as: * Adding final touches to the decorations * Placing candles, lanterns, and other decorative items * Preparing traditional Diwali sweets and snacks * Setting up the puja area (if you have one) Remember, it's better to focus on the essential tasks first and then move on to the smaller details.
